}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== Consists of the [Radxa NX5] and a NX5 IO Board
"Radxa NX5 V1.1", radxa logo and "20231020" :are silkscreened on SoM top. radxa logo, "MODEL: NX5 IO Board", :and "V1.4 2023.10.20" are silkscreened on the Carrier Board bottom
{{See also|Radxa|List of SBCs}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3588 @2.4GHz Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A76) :+ @1.8GHz Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A55) *GPU: ''Mali-G610'' MP4 (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.2); NPU Support 6T, :VPU (with 8K@60fps VP9 and 8K@30fps H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 32GB eMMC 5.1 flash, TF card (max.256GB)/MMC card *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4x) SDRAM ([[Micron]]) *Network: 1x GbE port *USB: 4x USB 3.0, 1x USB 2.0 (micro-B) (OTG) ports *PCI: 1x PCIe 2.1 M.2 (E-Key) slot *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 5V/4A via barrel
